description: an error thrown by a nextTick callback is an uncaughtException; the other ticks of its batch and the timers still run
argv: process.on('uncaughtException', (e) => console.log('caught', e.message)); process.nextTick(() => { throw new Error('t1'); }); process.nextTick(() => console.log('t2 still runs')); setTimeout(() => console.log('timer'), 5)
